# TODO 1.1.0

## Added
- Added: parent–child nested tasks with indent, collapse, and optional check cascading
- Added: soft Morandi-colored tag capsules with stable hash colors for light and dark themes
- Added: image attachment markers with hover preview instead of raw markdown embeds in the title
- Added: settings for parent–child check linking and optional nest guide lines

## Improved
- Improved: task rows use a single-line layout—checkbox, title, weak meta, then actions
- Improved: document group headers show fold control, short name, and count without repeating the source file on every row
- Improved: tag group headers use capsule chips and hide the leading `#`
- Improved: clearer visual weight for milestone and issue-style tasks
- Improved: `+` stays quiet until the row is hovered

## Fixed
- Fixed: Obsidian community review warnings for `builtin-modules`, multicolumn `column-gap`, and CSS `!important`
- Fixed: nested rows no longer squeeze the title into a vertical single-character column
- Fixed: local `dev` watch now deploys `main.js` and `styles.css` into Obsidian install folders for hot reload
